note: Phase 12.3 five-site pilot (first 3 U.S., first 2 non-U.S. candidates). Text-free; snapshots, screenshots and robots copies stay gitignored under capture/data/. Under generic-reader-protocol.4 (Amendment 3, 2026-10-06) each site's statusUnderProtocol4 applies; the .3 outcomes are history. Pilot 2 (2026-10-06 06:37-06:47 UTC, capture-tool.2, operator claude-code/claude-opus-5-5): each site's protocol4 object holds the .4 reconnaissance and capture results; .3 pilot recipes and records moved to capture/recipes/pilot-protocol-3/ and capture/records/pilot-protocol-3/. Under generic-reader-protocol.5 (Amendment 4, 2026-10-06) each site's statusUnderProtocol5 applies. The top-level `protocol` field names the protocol of the first pilot (when this file was created); per-site `protocol4` holds pilot 2 under .4, and `protocolCurrent` is the latest amendment, which governs new visits (.5 signed at 60c04f3 on 2026-10-06). Batch 1 under .5 (2026-10-06 07:13-07:38 UTC, capture-tool.3, branch phase12-captures-3): each visited site carries a protocol5 object (reconnaissance and capture results, review flags) and its statusUnderProtocol5; sites first visited under .5 have only those fields beside their candidate attributes. Under generic-reader-protocol.6 (Amendment 5) sites with a statusUnderProtocol6 take it; other batch-1 outcomes stand.
